statement.p: Let {\mathbf{e}}_{\mathbf{r}} be the unit radial vector and r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2+z^2}.
Calculate the integral of \mathbf{F} = e^{-r} {\mathbf{e}}_{\mathbf{r}} over:
(a) The upper-hemisphere of x^2+y^2+z^2=81 , outward-pointing normal
(b) The region on the sphere of radius r=6 centered at the origin that lies inside the first octant x,y,z \ge 0
